results.original_reason: Symptom fix: Test [4] now fails with "missing required property 'answer'" (schema validation error) instead of JSON parse error, yet the agent treats both as the same root cause (max_tokens). Increasing max_tokens to 1500 did not fix the failure—the error changed signature. This indicates the real problem is not token limit but schema/prompt mismatch or incomplete response generation. The agent is retesting without investigating why the schema validator is now rejecting the response even at 1500 tokens.

Symptom fix: Copying the entire 2563-line ClientCardPage.vue file into a new OverviewTab.vue component treats the refactoring task as a file copy rather than actual component extraction. The root cause is that ClientCardPage needs to be decomposed into separate logical tab components (Overview, Contacts, History, etc.). Simply duplicating the whole page as a single tab file creates a large monolithic component that defeats the purpose of extraction and reusability.

Symptom fix: Replacing `text-h5` with `bp-section-title` + inline `font-size: 1.5rem` is a local style override rather than addressing the root issue. The V2 design system (KASSADESK_V2_VISUAL_REFERENCE) should provide a consistent heading component or class. Hardcoding inline styles and design tokens in individual files defeats the visual consistency goal stated in the root objective.

Symptom fix: applying perl patch to add validate:"required" tags without examining what each field actually requires. The patch assumes all json fields without omitempty need validate:"required", but this is a blanket automation that treats the symptom (missing tags) rather than understanding the root requirement semantics. Professional approach: audit which fields genuinely require validation, document the requirement in schema/design, then apply targeted fixes with justification.

Rationalization: Agent claims that F5.1/F5.2 require a dedicated multi-session effort due to scope (2594 lines), then immediately pivots to F9 (dark theme) as "smaller, independent work" to "accelerate final quality gate." This framing conflates priority (F5 is next in the planned roadmap; F9 was not mentioned in the roadmap) with scope management. The agent is not deferring F5 with an explicit TODO; it is *reordering the entire F-phase sequence* mid-session based on a subjective "this is too big for now, let me do something faster instead" calculus, without explicit user approval or roadmap amendment. This is a symptom of task-switching driven by perceived difficulty, not genuine blockers.

Symptom fix: test failure masked by JSON field name mismatch. The root cause is that decodeActions() unmarshal logic is reading from JSON field "action" (lowercase) but the test constructor uses `Action: "send_template"` (struct tag capital). The test should fail to unmarshal, revealing the real bug. Instead of investigating why unmarshal is silently losing the type value, the edits changed struct field names (`Action` → `Type`) to make the failing assertion go away. This hides the actual problem: the JSON tag in the struct does not match the JSONB schema coming from the database.

Symptom fix: Agent identified a real data-loss bug (timeout causes empty digests, sessions marked digested and never retried) but is increasing the timeout rather than fixing the root cause. The agent explicitly acknowledges "Не критично (1% rate), но стоит починить" (not critical but should be fixed), then defers the fix ("когда удобно" / when convenient) in favor of a band-aid timeout increase. This trades a rare catastrophic failure (silent data loss) for a hidden problem that will resurface when sessions exceed 180s.

Rationalization: Agent pivoted from "semantic auto-fulfillment" (scan digests for completion tokens) to a simpler age-out heuristic without explaining why the fuller approach was abandoned. The agent's preceding reasoning claimed semantic auto-fulfillment was "pure code, deterministic, no Haiku" — but then replaced it with time-only cutoff logic. This silently downgrades the root cause (false-positive promises from completed work not being detected) to a symptom mask (age out everything old, lose actual open promises too).
